title: Graphic symbol loopMode/firstFrame not emitted in SWF
description: SymbolInstance.loopMode ('loop'|'play-once'|'single-frame') and firstFrame fields are parsed from FLA and respected by the authoring renderer (renderer.ts line 1012) but compile.ts never reads them — all graphic symbol instances always loop. Fix: in compile.ts symbol emit loop, emit a DoInitAction/PlaceObject with gotoAndStop(firstFrame) or stop() on the sprite based on loopMode. Affects packages/swf/src/compile.ts around the symbol-emit section.
